summary: Magnus Andersson discusses his concentrated investment philosophy focused on digital business models with strong moats and recurring revenue. He maintains only three major positions (Evolution Gaming, LVMH, and Netflix) and advocates for holding winners rather than strictly diversifying. Key themes include the importance of patience, understanding business models deeply, and being willing to hold concentrated positions in dominant companies even when valuations appear high relative to traditional metrics.
key_takeaways: Concentrated portfolios (3-4 holdings) can outperform diversified portfolios if you truly understand the businesses
High valuations may be justified for dominant companies with strong growth prospects and defensible moats
Digital business models with recurring revenue and competitive advantages are preferred
Patience and avoiding emotional trading during market volatility is crucial
Be willing to trim weeds and water flowers rather than automatically rebalancing to equal weights
